inngest/999-multibots-telegraf/periodic-.what: Tests both Telegram webhook URLs every hour and sends the admin a critical alarm when neither of them answers.

inngest/999-multibots-telegraf/check-stu.what: Finds model trainings still marked pending or processing past the stuck threshold and reconciles them against Replicate.
inngest/999-multibots-telegraf/check-stu.note: Records whose Replicate id is still a placeholder are skipped, because there is nothing on the provider to ask about.

inngest/999-multibots-telegraf/log-monit.what: Reads the application logs once a day, has a model summarise the errors and warnings, and sends the digest to Telegram.

inngest/999-multibots-telegraf/daily-sal.what: Builds every bot owner a morning report of yesterday's revenue, the week's costs and which services their users actually bought.
inngest/999-multibots-telegraf/daily-sal.note: One report per owner across all of their bots, assembled from the payments ledger rather than from a balance column.

inngest/999-multibots-telegraf/health-ch.what: Probes the main API and the Inngest service every half hour and reports what answered.

inngest/999-multibots-telegraf/skill-det.what: Mines successful generations for repeated model and prompt patterns once a day and saves the new ones as reusable skills.

timer/999-multibots-telegraf/production-.what: Re-runs the container, nginx, port, domain, webhook and system-resource checks, and applies the fixes that are enabled.
timer/999-multibots-telegraf/production-.note: Started only by running this module from the command line with the `monitor` argument; the bot's own entry point never starts it.

timer/999-multibots-telegraf/taskCache-L.what: Drops video-generation cache entries past their fifteen-minute lifetime so a finished task cannot block the next request.

timer/999-multibots-telegraf/notificatio.what: Drains the notification queue and delivers the Telegram messages waiting in it.
timer/999-multibots-telegraf/notificatio.note: Wrapped in an exclusive tick, so two bot processes cannot deliver the same notification twice.

timer/999-multibots-telegraf/notificatio.what: Deletes notification messages old enough that nobody is going to read them.

timer/999-multibots-telegraf/bot-owner-b.what: Recomputes every bot owner's debt from the payments ledger, warns them at the soft, warning and critical thresholds, and disables a bot that stays critical for three days.
timer/999-multibots-telegraf/bot-owner-b.note: The first run after a restart is skipped on purpose, and an owner whose payments cannot be read is left alone rather than accused.

timer/999-multibots-telegraf/crmProactiv.what: Runs one proactive seller turn for the owner: walks the CRM queue and puts the next draft card in front of them without being asked.
timer/999-multibots-telegraf/crmProactiv.note: The period is CRM_PROACTIVE_MINUTES from src/index.ts, thirty minutes by default; the first sweep waits two minutes after start.

timer/999-multibots-telegraf/video-task-.what: Forgets video tasks older than an hour and rewrites the store to disk when anything was removed.

timer/999-multibots-telegraf/provider-he.what: Checks every AI provider that is not parked and records whether it is currently answering.
timer/999-multibots-telegraf/provider-he.note: Providers listed in HEALTH_SKIP_PROVIDERS are deliberately not watched and do not raise the alarm.

timer/999-multibots-telegraf/generate-jo.what: Sweeps finished generation jobs out of memory an hour after they end, once a caller who lost the connection has had time to collect the result.

timer/999-multibots-telegraf/render-serv.what: Re-reads the session revocation list from Postgres so a revoked browser session stops being accepted.
timer/999-multibots-telegraf/render-serv.note: Only starts when a session signing key is configured; a deployed render server refuses to boot without one.

timer/999-multibots-telegraf/render-serv.what: Removes render jobs older than an hour from the in-memory job map.
Reads the hive journal and delivers the queen's report to the keepers, passing alarms straight through and batching ordinary events.
timer/999-multibots-telegraf/render-serv.note: Checks often and writes rarely: the cursor lives in the database, because this Railway project has no volume and a deploy wipes local state.

timer/999-multibots-telegraf/render-serv.what: Pings every websocket peer and drops the ones that did not answer the previous round.

timer/999-multibots-telegraf/agent-autop.what: Runs one autopilot cycle -- the generation pass and then the channel tick -- and skips the tick entirely when the previous cycle is still running.
timer/999-multibots-telegraf/agent-autop.note: Daemon mode only, under --loop or AUTOPILOT_LOOP=1; AUTOPILOT_INTERVAL_MS overrides the thirty-minute period, with a one-minute floor.

github-actions/999-multibots-telegraf/ci.what: Runs the whole build, type-check and test pipeline once a day so a dependency that rots without a push still gets caught.

github-actions/999-multibots-telegraf/se.what: Runs the weekly security sweep: secret detection over the full history, dependency audit and code scanning.

github-actions/t27/formal-mutation.what: Proves the formal gates actually bite by mutating the generated RTL once a week and requiring each gate to go red for its own mutation.
github-actions/t27/formal-mutation.note: Weekly rather than per-push because a full run costs about thirty yosys invocations.

github-actions/t27/pr-dashboard.what: Rebuilds the pull-request dashboard every hour from the current state of the open pull requests.

github-actions/trinity/agent-cron-cleanu.what: Finds agent deployments that got stuck and kills them, every two hours.

github-actions/trinity/agent-queue-drain.what: Looks for queued issues and free agent slots every five minutes and starts the next agent when there is room.

github-actions/trinity/brain-ci.what: Runs the weekly brain stress test, the long version of the health gate that every commit already gets.

github-actions/trinity/codegen.what: Validates the VIBEE code generator once a day, independently of whether anyone pushed.

github-actions/trinity/discover-callers.what: Reads GitHub for repositories that run the RTL check, so the gallery counts its own users instead of being hand-written.

github-actions/trinity/pages-health-chec.what: Fetches the published site every fifteen minutes, follows the redirect, and redeploys only when the evidence says the deploy is what broke.
github-actions/trinity/pages-health-chec.note: An earlier version judged a bare status code, failed ninety-six times a day on a site that was up, and dispatched a redeploy each time.

github-actions/trinity/signal-health-sel.what: Applies the signal-health check to the repository that sells it and writes the numbers into the website data.

github-actions/trinity/site-live-gate.what: Compares the content-hashed entry bundle served at the apex against a build of main, so that 'deployed' means a reader can actually see it.

railway-cron/999/jobsearch-cron.what: The scheduled job-search service of the Railway project, reachable at cron.t27.ai.
